dedupe_keys.name: gecad smart building full year datasets polytechnic of porto

description: These two datasets record a year of operation of an office building of the GECAD research group at the Polytechnic of Porto. The 2022 dataset covers five zones of two to three offices each with 3 to 6 researchers per zone, a meeting room and a server room, and records consumption by load type, HVAC units, light intensity and generation of a 7.5 kW photovoltaic system every 5 minutes; the 2024 dataset gives a cleaned year for one room with outdoor and indoor temperature, humidity, heat index, occupancy and air-conditioning status. Coverage is one building in Porto, Portugal. Access: Excel files on Zenodo (41 MB and 4 MB). Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the 2022 data are raw, with zero readings marking system failures and one HVAC unit removed from monitoring near year end; values marked x10 in the room file must be divided by ten. Simulation uses: load forecasting, demand response and HVAC control studies, and calibration of small office models. Related records: LBNL Building 59 three-year dataset and BLOND.
